note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Servers are started hidden by prepare (helper C:\lab\mgnet\svc.ps1) and their logs are shown with Get-Content/Select-String. The watcher is started inside the terminal scene (Start-Process -NoNewWindow) so its console lines appear live next to the typed commands; approvals in the group scene are done through the API (the browser click is equivalent). Browser screen: clean window at 125 % zoom.
